title: reviewer report
description: The review verdict. Only an `approve` verdict may lead to an LGTM on the pull request.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: the overall quality of the change and why it is (not) ready.

verdict.description: approve only when the change is correct, tested and free of blocking findings.

findings.description: Review findings. Empty when the change is clean.

fix.description: What the change should do instead.

cannot_verify.description: Requirements the reviewer could not settle from this diff alone. Never empty out of convenience: an unresolved entry means the verdict must be request_changes.

why.description: Why the diff alone does not settle it.

checked.description: What the reviewer did look at, or 'nothing'.

lgtm.description: True only when the reviewer posted an LGTM comment on the pull request.

pull_request.description: Number of the pull request that was reviewed.

issue_comment_url.description: URL of the comment the reviewer left on the pull request.

blocked.description: True when the reviewer could not review the change at all.

blocker_reason.description: Why the reviewer is blocked. Only meaningful when blocked is true.
